data.narrative:
Tomorrow.io is a Series E space and aerospace company that has raised $385M to date. Valuation analysis relies on two applicable triangulation methods drawn from a peer universe of 4 private-stage comparable companies in the same sector (ICEYE at $12.0B in Series F, Impulse Space at $4.3B in Series D, Apex Space at $2.3B in Series D, and Varda Space Industries at $1.6B in Series D), alongside a broader public comp set of 5 traded space companies with a median P/S multiple of 24.4x.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier to the $385M capital raised proxy, yielding $539M. The Peer-Median method anchors to the $3.3B median valuation across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, with a documented range of $1.6B to $12.0B. Public-comp anchoring via revenue multiples is not applicable, as private company revenue is not on file.

Triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $458M (low) to $3.8B (high), with a median of $1.9B. Key uncertainties include wide dispersion in peer valuations and the absence of revenue data to cross-check against public multiples. The valuation range reflects meaningful variation in how space-sector companies at similar stages are marked by investors.
